'''Alpha TR-8''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] prison on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rordak]]. It housed 5,452 prisoners, with 150 guards and hundred of [[Service droid/Legends|service droids]]. It was located five hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]] from a [[barthierum]] [[Mining/Legends|mine]]. Its [[Warden/Legends|warden]] was [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Drummond]].
